svg.title: Setting an A1c target in an adult with diabetes: if severe lows are unlikely, aim for 6.5% (low-risk type 2) or 7.0% (most people); if lows are likely or dangerous, or life is short, liberalize to 7.1-8.5% or stop measuring; each column gives who, why and what to do

svg.text: The A1c: the best-validated marker, but it LAGS

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • mean glucose over the last 8–12 weeks, ~50% from the last 30 days: changes lag behind glucose, so SMBG guides medication changes

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • misleading with altered red-cell turnover or hemoglobin (iron or B12 deficiency, chronic renal failure, hemoglobinopathies, splenectomy) → follow glucose readings instead
